Came from the portal, the enemy did something with pumpkins growing up in the suburbs of Popolion!
Pumpkins come to life and attack civilians. But we found a way to get rid of the curse!
Keeper, fight with pumpkins and bring me their pieces, then I will be able to impose the spell on them and give it to our healer to continue the ritual.
Hurry up!
Thanks for helping us to defeat monsters! You showed real strength and courage in the battles with monsters, take the well-deserved reward.

Not enough materials.

Scraps of cloth X 500
Pumpkin seeds X 250
Enchanted leaves X 100
Cursed substance X 100

Gather the needed materials and get a random reward chest!
